test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

He is **more wiser** than his brother.
solution:
The correct answer is '**wiser**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The word "**wiser**" is the correct comparative form of the adjective "wise."
 
• The sentence already contains the word "more," which is unnecessary because "wiser" itself denotes comparison.
 
• Using "more wiser" is redundant and grammatically incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"He is wiser than his brother."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "very wise"** is incorrect because it does not establish a comparison.
 
• **Option 2: "more wise"** is incorrect because "wiser" is the correct comparative form, not "more wise."
 
• **Option 3: "wiser to"** is incorrect as "to" is not the correct preposition to use in this context.
